# 1. Issue Imperial Sovereign Bonds (8-year cooldown)
oe_eco_v97_dec_issue_bonds = {
    decision_category = economy_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_eco_v97_bond_eligible = yes
    }
    allow = {
        custom_tooltip = {
            text = oe_eco_v97_bonds_cd_tt
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_eco_v97_bonds_cd }
        }
        stability >= -20
        inflation < 0.25
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_eco_v97_dec_issue_bonds.a
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_eco_v97_bonds_cd months = 96 }
            change_gold_effect = { scale = 12 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eco_v97_bond_service years = 8 mode = replace }
            oe_eco_v97_inject_bond_markets = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        inflation >= 0.15
                        war_exhaustion >= 6
                    }
                }
                trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_eco_v97.4 days = 60 }
            }
            else = {
                trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_eco_v97.3 days = 60 }
            }
        }
    }
}
